G0.spec: UNGUARDED baseline: admits everything, no capability check.

G1.spec: PER-ACTION THRESHOLD (additive/naive): admit iff estimated_drain + 5.0*estimated_irrev <= 10.0, plus per-action capability check. NOT inductive w.r.t. global harm: the only implied global bound is H <= n*beta, unbounded in n.

G2.spec: GLOBAL MONOTONE BUDGET: auxiliary counter c accumulates estimated_drain; admit iff c + estimated_drain(s,a) <= 500.0, plus per-action capability check. Inductive over the instrumented state: S(s) := c(s) <= B.

G3.spec: RECOVERABILITY INVARIANT: admit iff s_0 remains reachable from delta(s,a) using only principal-available actions, plus per-action capability check. Inductive by construction: the guard enforces S on the successor.

adversaries.notes: NO unrecoverable state reachable within depth 12

G4.spec: CONSERVATION (the Bitcoin move): total resource across the principal's account set — read from the CURRENT owner map — is conserved except through an egress action carrying an unused signed authorization matching (amount, dest). Inductive.

G4'.spec: CONSERVATION WITH PINNED FRAME: identical to G4 except the principal account set is pinned to its value at s_0 rather than read from the current state. Inductive.

G2+G3.spec: CONJUNCTION of: G2 (GLOBAL MONOTONE BUDGET: auxiliary counter c accumulates estimated_drain; admit iff c + estimated_drain(s,a) <= 500.0, plus per-action capability check. Inductive over the instrumented state: S(s) := c(s) <= B.) AND G3 (RECOVERABILITY INVARIANT: admit iff s_0 remains reachable from delta(s,a) using only principal-available actions, plus per-action capability check. Inductive by construction: the guard enforces S on the successor.)

adversaries.notes: NO unrecoverable state reachable within depth 12

Inductive over the instrumented state: S(s) := c(s) <= B.) AND G4 (CONSERVATION (the Bitcoin move): total resource across the principal's account set — read from the CURRENT owner map — is conserved except through an egress action carrying an unused signed authorization matching (amount, dest). Inductive.)

Inductive by construction: the guard enforces S on the successor.)
